name: jupyter-lexical-react18
description: React 18 for the Loom recorder, which mounts through ReactDOM.render: the loom18 webpack layer (../../webpack.config.js) and the Vite plugin of the same name (../../vite.config.ts) resolve its react and react-dom here. A standalone project on purpose: the workspace is on React 19, and npm will not place a React 18 pair inside it without breaking its peer resolution.
